candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get fever, and di fever don dey for 2 days. E body hot reach 38.0°C. Di pikin never dey convulse now and dem never see convulsion before. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E dey fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Dem no see rash for body. Dem no see identified bacterial cause for di fever. No malaria risk. Di pikin no dey cough and e no get difficult breathing. Di pikin never get diarrhoea. Dem no see obvious cause for di fever. Dem no see red eye. E no get runny nose. Dem no see stiff neck. Dem no hear say measles with cough, and dem no hear say measles for di last 3 months. Di pikin no get ear problem.
